comment: Production npm pin for Herdr plugin 0.51.0; core 0.51.0 (Pi 1.5.0 SDK set) is published to npm. The downloaded registry tarball's independently computed sha512 equals dist.integrity and its sha256 equals the accepted Windows-carrier core artifact. This closes the herdr-checkout verification window without an environment choice or acquisition fallback. Hosts moving from herdr-checkout to npm require explicit deactivate/activate, never inherited activation. Settled same-source npm installations may rebind under the plugin README's ownership conditions.
